title: Existence and cardinality of character-induced Heisenberg harmonic functions for finite probability measures
difficulty_reason: H2: the existing qualitative character-or-induction dichotomy does not determine which monotone inductions are finite at every group point. The author proves additional necessary and sufficient criteria by bounding the number of letters outside an abelian support face, rewriting all noncommutative word interlacings as weighted multi-time random-walk series, using centered recurrence versus drift summability in rank1, and controlling rank2 inductions by central commutator character values and tilted geometric sums. Combining these finiteness results with the actual support-generated subgroups and character Laplace levels gives the exact probability-measure counts0/2/1/uncountably-many. The nonroutine burden is the globally finite induction mechanism and its compatible rank/cone cases, not the elementary Chernoff or convexity lemma alone; the old2056 qualitative core is reused rather than counted again.

core_obligations: G=H3(Z), centerZ and abelian quotient embedded inV=R2 with V_mu^+ the convex cone generated by projected support; finite positive probability measure mu whose support generatesG as a group.
h_Gi,chi_i is the author monotone limit of P_mu^n applied to chi_i extended by0 outsideG_i; preserve left convolution, right translates and possible zero values of positive-cone functions.
The full-plane case has no induced function; the half-plane boundary line defines the actual support-generatedG0, with exactly2 canonical inductions if G0 intersect Z={0}, and none otherwise.
For a properly convex cone, each of its two boundary rays definesG_i; exactly1 canonical induction occurs when G_i intersect Z={0}, and uncountably many otherwise.

Rank1 finiteness uses the noncentered probability tilt chi0*mu0 and a globally finite sum over all word interlacings; rank2 pointed-cone finiteness uses the strict displayed commutator-character condition, with the necessary geometric restriction and maximal-abelian support choice.
Counts are of the specified canonical induced families, not all right translates or the entire cone of harmonic functions. Qualitative extremal classification remains existing2056.
No arbitrary finite positive-measure cardinality extension, semigroup-generation replacement, rank4 lattice repair, or independently certified proof is added.
